page.overview:
Who is Lowghen Badra?

Lowghen Badra was a Human pilot and friend of the Jedi Master Niquon.

Badra worked as a technician at his shop, Badra's Engineering and Repair on the planet Yabosta. One night while at work, Niquon's Padawan, Nason Laric, arrived with the remains of an assassin droid.

Badra disassembled the droid and determined it made use of lethal Drethi venom, and that Nason should return to Skalokor with the antidote. On their way, the pair was attacked by two groups of Rodians. Badra volunteered to hold them off, laying down a wall of counter-fire so Nason could reach his Cloudjumper and escape. Immediately after, an apprentice of the Dark Jedi Von Totha appeared to eliminate the young Jedi. Laric was able to defeat the overly-confident apprentice, allowing a limping Badra to approach the hangar and return with Laric to Yabosta.
